music.full:
Title: Saint Martin Lantern Parade Theme
Style of Music: Ambient medieval-inspired soundtrack, warm and reflective, featuring soft strings (viola, cello), gentle woodwinds (flute, duduk), subtle harp arpeggios, light low percussion (soft frame drum), 60‑70 
Instrumental, no vocals. Target length: about 4:21 (the video is 4:21 long).
Structure:
0:00  Quiet, misty intro with low cello drones and distant flute whispers to set a twilight autumn atmosphere
0:30  Warm string swell (viola, soft harp) as the cloak is shown, evoking the red‑brown fabric and ancient Roman setting
1:10  Subtle woodwind melody (flute/duduk) with light frame drum, underscoring Martin’s compassionate act of sharing his cloak
2:00  Gentle rhythmic pulse (soft hand‑drum) and brighter harp glissando as children march with glowing lanterns
3:30  Expansive, hopeful string harmony with a faint choir‑like pad (no vocal line) as the parade reaches the bonfire
4:21  Slow fade‑out of harp and low strings, leaving a lingering warm glow
Avoid: Loud percussion, heavy brass, melodic hooks that compete with narration, fast tempos, vocal samples
